api_version_skew.title: ha-spark API versions are incompatible
api_version_skew.description: The ha-spark add-on release {addon_release} speaks API version {addon_api_version} (supported: {addon_supported}). The integration sent API version {integration_api_version} and supports: {supported}. Update the add-on or integration so they support a common API version, then restart the updated half.

init.title: Solcast daily allowance
init.description: Choose 50 only for a legacy account with that allowance. Calls reset at midnight UTC.

error.no_sites: This Solcast account has no rooftop sites.
error.too_many_sites: This Solcast account has more than two rooftop sites.
error.malformed: Solcast returned an invalid site list.
error.quota_exhausted: The daily Solcast call allowance is exhausted. Try after midnight UTC.
error.busy: Solcast is busy. Try again later.
error.server_error: Solcast is unavailable. Try again later.
error.unreachable: Cannot reach Solcast. Try again later.
error.stale: The Solcast quota store could not be read or saved. Requests are stopped.

reconfigure.title: Configure Solcast
reconfigure.description: Enter your Solcast API key. Leave it empty to remove native Solcast after confirmation. Turn off other Solcast pollers before saving.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Solcast
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement Solcast API key.

clear_solcast.title: Remove native Solcast?
clear_solcast.description: Remove the saved key and sites? The add-on will use its legacy forecast entity settings.

confirm.title: ha-spark discovered
confirm.description: Connect the ha-spark add-on to this Home Assistant site?

abort.already_configured: This ha-spark site is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery is not from the ha-spark add-on or contains invalid connection data.
abort.addon_required: ha-spark is set up through its add-on. Install and start the ha-spark add-on: Home Assistant then discovers it and offers it here.
